name: Teen Summer Program
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of San Leandro
city: San Leandro, CA (Teen Clubhouse, 2200 San Leandro Blvd)
what_you_do: You pick hands-on classes such as digital media, cooking, sports, art, tech, wellness and college readiness. You make your own summer schedule at the teen clubhouse.
who_can_apply: High school students, rising 9th to 12th grade. The program page does not list a city rule.
pay_detail: Free for teens. This is a program, not a paid job.
deadline_text: The program page is for summer 2027 and says details are coming this spring. No dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Summer Starts Here button on the program page. It goes to the parent portal. Check back this spring for the class list.
notes: Hours are 10:00am to 5:30pm. The clubhouse has a tech center, recording studio, industrial kitchen and gym. The program page does not list jobs or paid internships. Phone: 510-483-5581. The same club runs a drop-in teen center for ages 13 to 18.
